advanced-react-performance-architecture.title: Advanced React 19, Concurrency & Enterprise Design Systems
advanced-react-performance-architecture.description: A 3-month intermediate-to-advanced React engineering cohort. Master React 19 Actions, Server Components (RSC), concurrent rendering, custom hooks architecture, design system engineering with Tailwind CSS, and state machines with Zustand.

autonomous-agentic-ai-mcp-architecture.title: Autonomous Agentic AI, MCP Server Architecture & Applied LLMs
autonomous-agentic-ai-mcp-architecture.description: A 4-month advanced AI engineering mentorship. Master autonomous multi-agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server architecture, local air-gapped LLMs with Ollama, vector-backed RAG, and production n8n automation.

enterprise-angular-scalable-architecture.title: Enterprise Angular, Signals & Scalable Architecture
enterprise-angular-scalable-architecture.description: A 3-month intermediate frontend mentorship for enterprise applications. Master Angular 18+, Signals reactivity, standalone components, RxJS stream orchestration, Nx Monorepos, and micro-frontend federation.

enterprise-nestjs-cqrs-architecture.title: Enterprise NestJS, Event-Driven Architectures & CQRS
enterprise-nestjs-cqrs-architecture.description: A 6-month intensive engineering mentorship. Master Domain-Driven Design, Hexagonal architecture, CQRS, and Event Sourcing using NestJS, Kafka, BullMQ, and Redis under high-throughput production constraints.

fullstack-docker-vps-deployment-crash-co.title: Full-Stack Docker, VPS & Production Deployment Crash Course
fullstack-docker-vps-deployment-crash-co.description: A 4-week zero-to-hero hands-on workshop for junior-to-mid developers. Learn Linux server setup, containerizing full-stack apps with Docker, setting up reverse proxies with SSL, and deploying live to a $5 VPS.

high-performance-postgresql-internals.title: High-Performance PostgreSQL Internals, Distributed Data & Query Optimization
high-performance-postgresql-internals.description: A 3-month intensive deep dive into PostgreSQL storage engines, MVCC locking mechanics, WAL replication, query planner internals, composite indexing strategies, and connection pooling under 20,000+ concurrent writes.

mobile-app-engineering-react-native.title: Cross-Platform Mobile App Engineering with React Native & Expo
mobile-app-engineering-react-native.description: A 3-month intensive cross-platform mobile development mentorship. Learn to build, profile, and publish high-performance iOS and Android applications using React Native, Expo Router, TypeScript, and offline-first storage.

modern-frontend-react-astro.title: Modern Frontend Engineering with React, Astro & TypeScript
modern-frontend-react-astro.description: A 3-month intermediate frontend development bootcamp. Master component architectures, strict TypeScript, state machines, performance profiling, Islands Architecture with Astro, and Tailwind CSS design systems.

modern-php-symfony-architecture.title: Modern PHP 8.x, Symfony Components & Production Architecture
modern-php-symfony-architecture.description: A 3-month intermediate-to-advanced engineering cohort. Master modern PHP 8.3+, OOP design patterns, Hexagonal architecture with Symfony components, REST/GraphQL APIs, and Dockerized production environments.

production-flutter-dart-engineering.title: Production Flutter & Dart Mobile App Engineering
production-flutter-dart-engineering.description: A 3-month intermediate-to-advanced mobile engineering cohort. Master Dart 3+, BLoC pattern, Clean Architecture, local Isolate multithreading, offline caching with Drift (SQLite), and CI/CD pipelines for Android & iOS.

production-kubernetes-baremetal-devops.title: Production Kubernetes, Bare-Metal VPS & Cloud-Native DevOps
production-kubernetes-baremetal-devops.description: A 4-month intensive hands-on infrastructure mentorship. Master bare-metal Linux hardening, multi-stage Docker builds, Kubernetes cluster orchestration, Traefik ingress routing, automated CI/CD, and Prometheus/Grafana observability.

system-architecture-mastery.title: Enterprise System Architecture, Microservices & Autonomous AI Engineering
system-architecture-mastery.description: A 12-month rigorous, career-defining apprenticeship for engineers. Master distributed systems, high-throughput microservices, Kubernetes orchestration, and agentic workflows with 2 weekly live sessions and 1-on-1 hand-holding.
